+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""A small, local task tracker with JSON-backed persistence."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import sys
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Sequence
+
+DEFAULT_STORE = Path.home() / ".task-tracker.json"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Task:
+    id: int
+    title: str
+    created_at: str
+    completed: bool = False
+    completed_at: str | None = None
+
+
+class TaskStore:
+    """Persist tasks to a single JSON file."""
+
+    def __init__(self, path: Path) -> None:
+        self.path = path
+
+    def load(self) -> list[Task]:
+        if not self.path.exists():
+            return []
+
+        try:
+            payload = json.loads(self.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
+            raise ValueError(f"Task file is not valid JSON: {self.path}") from error
+
+        if not isinstance(payload, list):
+            raise ValueError(f"Task file must contain a list: {self.path}")
+
+        try:
+            return [Task(**item) for item in payload]
+        except (TypeError, ValueError) as error:
+            raise ValueError(f"Task file contains an invalid task: {self.path}") from error
+
+    def save(self, tasks: list[Task]) -> None:
+        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        content = json.dumps([asdict(task) for task in tasks], indent=2) + "\n"
+        self.path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def now() -> str:
+    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
+
+
+def find_task(tasks: list[Task], task_id: int) -> Task:
+    for task in tasks:
+        if task.id == task_id:
+            return task
+    raise ValueError(f"No task found with ID {task_id}.")
+
+
+def add_task(store: TaskStore, title: str) -> Task:
+    title = title.strip()
+    if not title:
+        raise ValueError("Task title cannot be empty.")
+
+    tasks = store.load()
+    task = Task(
+        id=max((item.id for item in tasks), default=0) + 1,
+        title=title,
+        created_at=now(),
+    )
+    tasks.append(task)
+    store.save(tasks)
+    return task
+
+
+def complete_task(store: TaskStore, task_id: int) -> Task:
+    tasks = store.load()
+    task = find_task(tasks, task_id)
+    if task.completed:
+        raise ValueError(f"Task {task_id} is already complete.")
+
+    task.completed = True
+    task.completed_at = now()
+    store.save(tasks)
+    return task
+
+
+def delete_task(store: TaskStore, task_id: int) -> Task:
+    tasks = store.load()
+    task = find_task(tasks, task_id)
+    tasks.remove(task)
+    store.save(tasks)
+    return task
+
+
+def format_tasks(tasks: list[Task]) -> str:
+    if not tasks:
+        return "No tasks found."
+
+    width = len(str(max(task.id for task in tasks)))
+    rows = []
+    for task in tasks:
+        marker = "x" if task.completed else " "
+        rows.append(f"{task.id:>{width}}  [{marker}]  {task.title}")
+    return "\n".join(rows)
+
+
+def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        description="Manage a simple local list of tasks.",
+        formatter_class=argparse.ArgumentDefaultsHelpFormatter,
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--file",
+        type=Path,
+        default=DEFAULT_STORE,
+        help="Path to the JSON task store",
+    )
+    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
+
+    add = commands.add_parser("add", help="Add a task")
+    add.add_argument("title", help="Task description")
+
+    list_command = commands.add_parser("list", help="List tasks")
+    list_command.add_argument(
+        "--all", action="store_true", help="Include completed tasks"
+    )
+
+    complete = commands.add_parser("complete", help="Mark a task complete")
+    complete.add_argument("id", type=int, help="Task ID")
+
+    delete = commands.add_parser("delete", help="Delete a task")
+    delete.add_argument("id", type=int, help="Task ID")
+    return parser
+
+
+def run(arguments: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    args = build_parser().parse_args(arguments)
+    store = TaskStore(args.file)
+
+    try:
+        if args.command == "add":
+            task = add_task(store, args.title)
+            print(f"Added task {task.id}: {task.title}")
+        elif args.command == "list":
+            tasks = store.load()
+            if not args.all:
+                tasks = [task for task in tasks if not task.completed]
+            print(format_tasks(tasks))
+        elif args.command == "complete":
+            task = complete_task(store, args.id)
+            print(f"Completed task {task.id}: {task.title}")
+        elif args.command == "delete":
+            task = delete_task(store, args.id)
+            print(f"Deleted task {task.id}: {task.title}")
+    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
+        print(f"Error: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(run())

+from pathlib import Path
+
+from task_tracker import Task, TaskStore, add_task, complete_task, delete_task, format_tasks, run

+def test_add_assigns_ids_and_persists_tasks(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    store = TaskStore(tmp_path / "tasks.json")
+
+    first = add_task(store, "Write documentation")
+    second = add_task(store, "Ship release")
+
+    assert (first.id, second.id) == (1, 2)
+    assert [task.title for task in store.load()] == ["Write documentation", "Ship release"]
+

+def test_complete_marks_task_with_timestamp(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    store = TaskStore(tmp_path / "tasks.json")
+    task = add_task(store, "Review pull request")
+
+    completed = complete_task(store, task.id)
+
+    assert completed.completed is True
+    assert completed.completed_at is not None
+    assert store.load()[0].completed is True

+def test_delete_removes_task_without_reusing_existing_ids(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    store = TaskStore(tmp_path / "tasks.json")
+    first = add_task(store, "First")
+    second = add_task(store, "Second")
+
+    delete_task(store, first.id)
+    third = add_task(store, "Third")

+    assert [task.id for task in store.load()] == [second.id, third.id]

+def test_run_reports_missing_task_as_error(tmp_path: Path, capsys) -> None:

+
+```bash
+# Add a task

+
+# Mark a task complete, or remove it

+# Include completed tasks or use a project-local task file
